title: Zahid Khan v. State of U.P.
coram: Krishna Murari, J.; Ajay Bhanot, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; relegated to Clause 6.5 alternative remedy.
headnote: A writ challenging the correctness and accuracy of an electricity consumption bill is not maintainable where Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 supplies a statutory alternative remedy before the competent authority. The petition is dismissed with liberty to avail that remedy.
facts: Zahid Khan petitioned the Allahabad High Court in writ, challenging the correctness and accuracy of a bill for consumption of electrical energy. The respondents were the State of Uttar Pradesh and four others. Counsel for the petitioner and for respondents 3 to 5 were heard. The order discloses no further particulars of the connection, billing period, or the amount in dispute.

holding_units.holding: Where the writ challenges the correctness and accuracy of an electricity consumption bill, Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 affords a statutory alternative remedy of approaching the competent authority; the writ is not to be entertained and stands dismissed with liberty to avail that remedy.

not_decided.point: correctness and accuracy of the electricity consumption bill
not_decided.note: Left open for the Clause 6.5 statutory remedy.
